title: Patch: No Shell, Please
story: Build the ping command as a list, and only for a plain hostname or address.
goal: Write ping_cmd(host) returning ["ping", "-c", "1", host], or raising ValueError for a bad host.
hints: A list of arguments never goes through a shell. Validate the host with a regular expression first.
Allow only letters, digits, dots and hyphens: ^[A-Za-z0-9.-]+$
socratic: Compare your output with the goal. What differs?
explain: In one sentence: what was the bug, and how did you fix it?
